title: FIVE-STAGE FAMILY CEILING ANALYSIS (0141 methodology on [Z78G]): independent exact rational re-verification of the endpoint comparison layer PASS (12 rows x true region, all positive at the claimed theta); the adopted record is NOT at its family ceiling - the comparison system still clears to delta = 1e-9 and fails at delta = 2e-8, with the class bound at theta* = theta - delta*, delta* in (1.5e-8, 2e-8), delta* approx 1.69e-8 (binding row: top/affine region row, margin 1.475e-7 at theta, net sensitivity approx 8.74 per unit delta); a same-family successor can legitimately claim down toward approx 0.874808683 (>= 87480869/10^9 immediately certifiable above the 1e-15 box error budget); the next real step remains a new structural cycle
body: Continued the 0141 ceiling methodology on the ADOPTED five-stage family (gao-five-step-affine-20261020, [Z78G], theta = 8748087/10^7) using the byte-verified replay source at tmp/b6audit/tracker/gao5_replay/work/src/Candidate (1514 files). WORKSPACE: tmp/b6audit/tracker/opt5/ (ceiling5.py + this entry). (1) FROZEN DATA IDENTIFIED (all exact rationals, no continuous free parameters at the endpoint layer): the five priced stages FixedStages.stage0..4 with q = 127604383/200000000 = 0.638021915, 676506091/10^9 = 0.676506091, 693781289/10^9 = 0.693781289, 142343339/200000000 = 0.711716695, 730301837/10^9 = 0.730301837 (exactly the paper's five junctions); each stage carries exact (~15-90 digit rational) lam/price/intercept from the 'priced five-stage argument' with per-stage gates norm_num-verified (amplifierRatio <= 7, slope <= 5, lam <= 6*price, lam <= 6*old, low-reserve caps), zeroSaving = 1/20 (root) + 1/100 x 4, primeFraction 99/100; TERMINAL STAGE stage4 uses price = 4499/6000 (the Akash-Levy price 2*BetaBound-1) and intercept = 1 as the structural price. lambda = stage0.lam (15-digit bracketed 3.74133137186239...), B = Coordinates.outerB (0.98202950630894...), h = 79716116522/10^11, top = 2019049/5e7, plainTop = 264/625, countCap = (1-81/200-264/625)/(9/2). (2) ENDPOINT COMPARISON LAYER REPLICATED IN EXACT RATIONAL PYTHON (Fractions): the Consumer layer (ConsumerParameters.lean verbatim: newCapacity/oldCapacity, V/D/P/J, common, affineSI/SP/A/N/D, cappedN/D, plain, oldCleared/affineCleared/cappedCleared/plainMargin) + the row map from TopRows.lean / JunctionOldRows.lean / Bernstein/EndpointRows.lean: TOP ROW (L = h, C = newCapacity(h), saving = topSaving = 1/25e6) and JUNCTION ROW (L = dMinus, C = oldCapacity(dMinus) = (2y-dMinus)/(6*kappa*), saving = rowSaving = 1/50e6), with kappa* = 2theta-1, ell = 11/3-4theta, y = h-2ell, dMinus = 2y/(lambda*countCap+2-B); the (d,p) domain [0,3/4]x[0,1/2] decomposed EXACTLY as the proof's outside_cases plus the region box; CountAffine.inRegion = {43/100 <= d <= 49/100, 495/1000 <= p <= 1/2} = the R box used (no conservatism). (3) INDEPENDENT RE-VERIFICATION AT THE CLAIMED THETA: PASS - all 12 row-box minima strictly positive in exact arithmetic (minima at corners/edges as the kernel-verified record requires): binding = top/affine region row, min = +1.4750e-7 at (d = 0.46315, p = 1/2); top/capped +6.4e-7; top/plain +6.54e-4; top/old A/B/C +2.0e-4..4.9e-4; junction rows +3.0e-4..2.8e-3. (Grid note: a coarse 49x81 bisection earlier MISSED the binding minimum (minimizer sits between grid lines at d = 0.46315); the 401x401 pass is the correct one - recorded as a probe-hygiene lesson: near-zero minima need fine grids on every axis.) (4) THETA' DESCENT (exact Fractions, delta in 10^-9 units, binding row at 401x401): margin(0) = +1.4750e-7, margin(1e-8) = +6.01e-8, margin(1.5e-8) = +1.64e-8, margin(2e-8) = -2.73e-8; linear crossing gives delta* approx 1.69e-8 (certified bracket: 1.5e-8 < delta* < 2e-8). Net sensitivity of the binding margin to theta: approx 8.74 per unit (theta enters the affine row through (theta - saving - common) directly AND through ell = 11/3-4theta, kappa* = 2theta-1, y, dMinus, capacities - the offset depth is amplified ~8.7x structurally). (5) CEILING VERDICT: the adopted record is NOT at its family ceiling (contrast 0141, where the two-level family sat exactly at its corner): with the five-stage config frozen, the comparison-system class bound is theta* = theta - delta* with delta* in (1.5e-8, 2e-8), i.e. theta* in (0.87480868, 0.874808685), numerically approx 0.8748086832. A successor record built on the SAME five-stage construction (same stages, same ledger, same Bernstein machinery regenerated at the deeper offset) can legitimately claim down toward theta*; at theta - 1e-9 the binding margin is approx 1.39e-9, comfortably above the 1e-15 geometric box-error budget (the 62+ Bernstein boxes carry margin_gt of order 1e-9..1e-14, e.g. Certificate00 margin > 157/10^11), so e.g. 87480869/10^9 = 0.87480869 is immediately certifiable and deeper claims consume the remaining margin down to theta*. Caveats (stated exactly): (i) stage data frozen - the priced-stage recursion at a different theta' could only improve on this bound (the true family infimum is <= approx 0.874808683), so the headline direction (headroom exists) is robust; (ii) the 62-box geometric certificate layer was not re-discharged at theta' (routine regeneration, margin analysis above bounds its cost); (iii) this is comparison-layer analysis, the final endpoint theorem also pays the recovery/transport legs which are theta-monotone in the same direction (they only get easier as theta' < theta - the comparison is a lower bound on the true system infimum gap in the safe direction). (6) PROGRAM CONSEQUENCES: (a) the board's NEXT same-family record (value in [0.87480868, 0.8748087)) will trip watcher channel 1 (merged value < ADOPTED) and be absorbed by the demonstrated B6 section-8 conveyor without any new in-tree design work; (b) the 0141+0144 pair now constitute a proven per-family ceiling toolkit: find the priced stages/ledger constants -> exact-rational replica of the endpoint comparison -> theta' bisection -> binding row identification; (c) toward the RH Final Solution this headroom (approx 1.7e-8) is dust relative to the 0.3748087 face width - the decisive step remains a NEW STRUCTURAL CYCLE (the 0141 forecast, now confirmed for the second adopted family in a row), and the 0143 map indicates where: the comparison systems are being squeezed to their exact infima (Liu 2610.26835 names the quartic root B_flat = 0.87488664703996... as 'the exact infimum of the refined comparison system, unattained by finite chains starting above it' for the previous system stage; the five-stage system is now doing the same at 0.87480868...). The next system - not the next offset - is where the Final Solution moves. NO RH CLAIM; no in-tree change (nothing to adopt - the headroom belongs to the tracker's own next submission, not to a stronger external input); the in-tree state remains [Z78G] + face hOffG, full tree green.
